goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried to gear up at the locker room racks and the truck reel, but every Grab prompt (axe, extinguisher, hose) returned 'held, not triggered'. The backpack stayed empty and the round stayed in Lobby, so no fires were fought, no one was rescued and no water was refilled. The probe also logged a LobbyService script error that probably explains why the round never started.

bugs.title: LobbyService server error: attempt to index nil with 'pads'
bugs.evidence: The ForgeProbe error is 'ServerScriptService.Services.LobbyService:7: attempt to index nil with 'pads''. The playtesters report RoundState stuck on 'Lobby' through step 8, so the round never started.

bugs.title: Gear rack and hose reel prompts never trigger
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3 and 4: 'Grab Axe' on GearRack1 returned 'held, not triggered' at about 8 and 3.5 studs, with both path interact and a raw E press. Step 5: 'Grab Extinguisher' on GearRack2 failed the same way. Steps 7 and 8: 'Grab Hose' on the truck Reel (6 studs, 1.5s hold) also failed. Carrying stayed '' throughout. This blocks the core loop. It may be a consequence of the Lobby state or the LobbyService error, but the trace does not show the cause.

bugs.title: Round stuck in Lobby, so there are no fires or rescues to play
bugs.evidence: The playtesters report RoundState 'Lobby' for the whole session. No fire, rescue or refill events appear in the game events, only traffic and save counters. The goal of playing a full round could not be attempted.
